title: The man who phoned in Canada's most famous UFO sighting became the face of the mystery
description: The Oct. 4, 1967, Shag Harbour event is considered Canada's most famous UFO incident. Laurie Wickens became the public face of the mystery, a role he kept until his recent death at 76.
text:
The October 4, 1967, Shag Harbour event is considered Canada's most famous UFO incident. Laurie Wickens became the public face of the mystery, a role he kept until his recent death at 76. As 17-year-old Laurie Wickens drove some friends home from a dance on a clear October 1967 night, he spotted lights in the sky.

Wickens drove to a phone booth and called the RCMP. "When he answered, it was the RCMP," said his daughter, Stephanie Wickens. "And they're like, 'Mr.

Wickens, stay where you're at.
